column1: # derivation: §9.10: NTH_VALUE(x, n) is the value of the frame's n-th row,
# counting from 1 and counting rows whose value is NULL; NULL when the frame
# has fewer than n rows. nth_v = NTH_VALUE(v, 2) over ROWS 1 PRECEDING .. 1
# row: NULL. nth_w = NTH_VALUE(w, 3) over ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING .. CURRENT
# ROW: g = 1: NULL, NULL (one and two rows), then 30 for ids 3 to 5; g = 2:
# A frame stays within the current row's partition: standard SQL window
# semantics, which no item states yet.
# Types: id, g, v, w, u keep their scanned types; NTH_VALUE has the input's
# type, INT64, and is always nullable (§8.25).
